description:
Music video animated by Koronosuke Koron for the song Ano Yume wo Nazotte by YOASOBI.

Note: There exists two versions of this video; the first being a Japanese version uploaded on January 18, 2020 and an English version of the song titled "Tracing A Dream" also by YOASOBI, which was uploaded on November 11, 2021.
